messages:
Maria: @priya quick sync on Constellation POC — they want to bring a custom 27B variant (quantized) and need demonstration of latency <200ms p95 for typical 512-token prompts, plus SOC2/KMS requirements. any immediate red flags?
Priya: couple notes: tokenizers are the usual first fail - ask for the tokenizer.json and merges. quantized 27B can be finicky with Triton kernels; need to know which quant scheme (q4_0/q4_1/q8_*) they used. also need expected concurrency/seq distribution.
Kevin: i'll run a compatibility probe once we have the artifact. what i need: model.tar with config.json, pytorch state or ONNX and the tokenizer files. critical checkpoints: kv-cache format (we expect [seq, heads, head_dim] layout), rotary vs alibi attention, and whether they use any custom ops. if custom ops -> recompile or adapter.
Maria: ok i asked them to upload to secure bucket. pricing question from their procurement — should we quote hosted burst or reserved dedicated for the POC? they expect ~1k qps but mostly short sessions (avg 150 tokens).
Diego: for early POC we usually do hosted with a burst cap + temporary dedicated eval credits. i'll propose: hosted usage + 2-week dedicated staging slot at no extra cost. gives them perf numbers without long commit. want me to draft?
Maria: yes please, draft and cc me. also they're asking about encryption in transit+at-rest and KMS access.
Jen: i can cover that. answer summary: we support TLS in transit, at-rest encryption and customer-managed keys for Private deployments. for Redwood-hosted we offer envelope encryption and can do KMS integrations for Enterprise. SOC2: we can provide our controls and current audit timeline. can you forward the questionnaire?
Maria: forwarded. there are a few legal asks around data residency and retention. they want deletion after 30 days unless otherwise agreed.
Priya: ops heads-up: quantized weight paging + large KV cache may require tuning memory footprint. recommend starting with 48GB GPU mem profile and enable continuous batching. also we should enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts.
Kevin: i'll add a short checklist i'm going to run once we have artifacts:
```
- verify tokenizer files and vocab_size match config.json
- confirm attention type and kvcache tensor layout
- run small perf pass (1 requester, seq=512, beam=1)
- validate embedding dims if they use embeddings API
```
Kevin: one more: if their embedding dim != 1536 (our default test harness) we need to note cross-model search implications. not blocking for inference but impacts downstream retrieval.
Jen: security blocker: if they want customer-managed KMS in Hosted mode, we need SOC/legal approval; that'll add ~10 business days. recommend Private for their compliance needs.
Diego: i'll coordinate calendar for demo week of Apr 6, and attach standard POC contract template.
Maria: timeline sensible. target: artifacts by Fri, internal compatibility check by Mon, demo Tue. Priya/Kevin/Jen — add any blockers here.
Priya: blocker: if model uses nonstandard cuda kernels we may need an engineering build; add 3-4 days.
Kevin: blocker: tokenizer mismatch or unexpected special tokens will slow onboarding. but we can provide a tokenizer adapter patch in most cases.
Jen: blocker: final sign-off on KMS/SLA from legal — typically 7-14 days depending on contract clauses.
Maria: got it. i'll summarize and send to Constellation. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
